title: Law to raise salaries for the mayor, Council and other officials
summary: This law would raise the salaries of the mayor, public advocate, comptroller, Council members, borough presidents and district attorneys by 18.2 percent, retroactive to January 1, 2026, following a recommendation from the 2026 Quadrennial Advisory Commission. It also moves future compensation reviews to the third year of a term instead of the first, giving each review commission 120 days to complete its work, and adds automatic cost-of-living adjustments if a commission is not convened. New salaries include $305,800 for the mayor, $175,500 for Council members and $251,500 for district attorneys.
